params.1274: To craft gold jewellery you need a mould (ring, necklace, bracelet or amulet).
params.1275: You also need some gold bars, which you can get by mining gold ore and smelting it in a furnace.
params.1276: With the gold bars and mould(s) in your inventory, use the gold bars on any furnace and choose which piece of jewellery to create.
